     1	\section{Spatial white noise: energy and explicit moment bounds}
     2	\label{S:intrinsic-white-evaluation}
     3	
     4	Take $d = \alpha = 1$ and $\Gamma = c\delta_0$, $c \ge 0$, with temporal kernel
     5	$|s-t|^{-a}$, $0 < a < 1$, and data $(1,0)$. The parameter $c$ is covariance
     6	mass; the coefficient of unit noise would be $\sqrt c$. No additional temporal
     7	normalization is inserted. The wave kinetic coefficient is one. For real unit $f
     8	\in H^1(\R)$ put $A = \int_\R f^4$ and $b = \int_\R(f')^2$. The physical
     9	covariance is $A_{\mathrm{sp}}(f) = cA$.
    10	
    11	The next calculation recovers the sharp one-dimensional interpolation
    12	inequality recorded by Sz.-Nagy~\cite{sz.nagy:source1941:integralungleichungen}*{(2),
    13	p.~64, and (4), p.~65}, now commonly called a Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequality,
    14	and its hyperbolic-secant optimizer. We give the proof to fix the normalization
    15	of the spatial energy.
    16	
    17	\begin{lemma}[A square identity for the distribution function]\label{L:white-cdf-square}
    18	  Every such $f$ has $A < \infty$. With $\mathsf{F}(x) =
    19	  \int_{-\infty}^xf(y)^2\ud y$, for every real $z$,
    20	  \begin{equation}\label{E:white-cdf-square}
    21	    0\le\int_\R[f'-zf(1-2\mathsf{F})]^2
    22	    =b-2zA+z^2/3 .
    23	  \end{equation}
    24	\end{lemma}
    25	
    26	\begin{proof}
    27	  On a bounded interval the weak derivative $f'$ is $L^1$ by Cauchy--Schwarz.
    28	  Its integral primitive has weak derivative $f'$ by Fubini. Subtracting it from
    29	  $f$ gives a function of weak derivative zero, hence constant almost
    30	  everywhere: test against derivatives of compact smooth primitives of all
    31	  zero-integral test functions. The resulting locally absolutely continuous
    32	  representatives patch on overlaps, giving one continuous representative. Thus,
    33	  $\rho = f^2$ is locally absolutely continuous with $\rho' = 2ff' \in L^1(\R)$,
    34	  while $\rho \ge 0$ and $\int\rho = 1$. Integrability of $\rho'$ makes $\rho$
    35	  Cauchy on each infinite tail, so it has finite limits at both ends. Its $L^1$
    36	  integrability forces both limits to be zero. It is therefore bounded, and $A =

    58	\begin{proposition}[Exact white spatial energy]\label{P:white-spatial-energy}
    59	  For $c > 0$,
    60	  \[
    61	    R_{\mathrm{sp}}=c/\sqrt3,\qquad
    62	    \mathcal{E}_{\mathrm{sp}}=c^2/6.
    63	  \]
    64	  Both values are zero at $c = 0$.
    65	\end{proposition}
    66	
    67	\begin{proof}
    68	  Substitution $z = 3A$ into~\eqref{E:white-cdf-square} gives $3A^2 \le b$. This
    69	  is the exact premise and conclusion of the existing conditional WhiteCDF
    70	  square deduction. Here $A > 0$, since $A = 0$ would imply $f = 0$ a.e. Also $b
    71	  > 0$: zero derivative makes its continuous representative constant and hence
    72	  zero in $L^2$, contradicting unit mass. Thus, $A/\sqrt b \le 1/\sqrt3$.
    73	
    74	  For $\ell > 0$ use the real smooth $H^1$ profile $f_\ell(x) =
    75	  \sqrt{\ell/2}\operatorname{sech}(\ell x)$, with $f_\ell' = -\ell\tanh(\ell
    76	  x)f_\ell$. Set $t = \tanh(\ell x)$, so $\ud t = \ell\operatorname{sech}^2(\ell
    77	  x)\ud x$. Direct integration gives
    78	  \[
    79	    \int f_\ell^2=\frac12\int_{-1}^1\ud t=1,\quad
    80	    \int f_\ell^4=\frac\ell4\int_{-1}^1(1-t^2)\ud t=\ell/3,\quad
    81	    \int(f_\ell')^2=\frac{\ell^2}2\int_{-1}^1t^2\ud t=\ell^2/3.
    82	  \]
    83	  The ratio is attained, proving $R_{\mathrm{sp}} = c/\sqrt3$. The physical
    84	  Dirac measure introduces no Fourier constant or nonintegrable kernel
    85	  $|x|^{-1}$. The existing conditional energy deduction applies to $3A^2 \le b$:
    86	  \[
    87	    cA-b/2\le cA-\tfrac32A^2
    88	    =c^2/6-\tfrac32(A-c/3)^2\le c^2/6 .
    89	  \]
    90	  At $\ell = c > 0$ the profile attains $c^2/6$. These are full $H^1$ energy
    91	  profiles; compact approximation equality is
    92	  Proposition~\ref{P:spatial-four-linear}, not a claim that the noncompact
    93	  profile itself is a compact stochastic control. At $c = 0$ the ratio is zero
    94	  and the energy is $\sup(-b/2) = 0$, approached by $f_\ell$ as
    95	  $\ell\downarrow0$. No zero-scale profile is used as a unit vector. The CDF,
    96	  integral and attainment arguments remain analytic; the two finite conditional
    97	  deductions do not formalize them. This proves
    98	  Proposition~\ref{P:white-spatial-energy}.
    99	\end{proof}

  7572	\begin{lemma}[White-space low-order Laplace transforms]
  7573	  \label{L:white-clock-laplace}
  7574	  The \((1,1)\) cross-pair gap transform is
  7575	  \begin{equation}\label{E:white-cross-clock-transform}
  7576	    \begin{split}
  7577	      K_\times(\theta_1,\theta_2)
  7578	      &:=\int_0^\infty\int_0^\infty
  7579	      e^{-\theta_1s-\theta_2t}|s-t|^{-a}
  7580	      \frac{\min(s,t)}2\ud s\ud t\\
  7581	      &=\frac{\Gamma_{\mathrm{E}}(1-a)}
  7582	      {2(\theta_1+\theta_2)^2}
  7583	      \big(\theta_1^{a-1}+\theta_2^{a-1}\big),
  7584	      \qquad \theta_1,\theta_2>0.
  7585	    \end{split}
  7586	  \end{equation}
  7587	  In particular, \(K_\times(\theta,\theta)=
  7588	  \Gamma_{\mathrm{E}}(1-a)/(4\theta^{3-a})\). For the empty-plus-length-two
  7589	  self-pair, independent gap damping gives
  7590	  \begin{equation}\label{E:white-self-clock-transform}
  7591	    K_{\rm self}(\eta_1,\eta_2)
  7592	    :=\int_0^\infty\int_0^\infty
  7593	    e^{-\eta_1r_1-\eta_2r_2}r_2^{-a}\frac{r_1}2

  7595	    =\frac{\Gamma_{\mathrm{E}}(1-a)}
  7596	    {2\eta_1^2\eta_2^{1-a}}.

    16	  integrand `e^{-θ₁ s - θ₂ t} |s-t|^{-a} min(s,t)/2` is integrable on the open
    17	  quadrant `(0,∞)²`, its integral over the quadrant and its iterated integral
    18	  `∫_0^∞ (∫_0^∞ · ds) dt` (the TeX order) both equal
    19	  `Γ_E(1-a)/(2(θ₁+θ₂)²) (θ₁^{a-1} + θ₂^{a-1})`;
    20	* the diagonal value `K_×(θ,θ) = Γ_E(1-a)/(4 θ^{3-a})`;
    21	* `E:white-self-clock-transform`: the integrand
    22	  `e^{-η₁ r₁ - η₂ r₂} r₂^{-a} r₁/2` is integrable on the quadrant and its
    23	  quadrant and iterated (`∫_0^∞ (∫_0^∞ · dr₁) dr₂`) integrals equal
    24	  `Γ_E(1-a)/(2 η₁² η₂^{1-a})`;

    30	* The self transform's damping parameters `η₁, η₂` are not given a sign in the
    31	  TeX (line 7589, "independent gap damping"); the integral converges only for

   435	    (IntegrableOn (crossIntegrand a θ₁ θ₂) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
   436	      ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ),
   437	          exp (-θ₁ * s - θ₂ * t) * |s - t| ^ (-a) * (min s t / 2) =
   438	        Gamma (1 - a) / (2 * (θ₁ + θ₂) ^ 2) * (θ₁ ^ (a - 1) + θ₂ ^ (a - 1))) ∧
   439	    (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ →
   440	      IntegrableOn (crossIntegrand a θ θ) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
   441	        ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ),
   442	            exp (-θ * s - θ * t) * |s - t| ^ (-a) * (min s t / 2) =
   443	          Gamma (1 - a) / (4 * θ ^ (3 - a))) ∧
   444	    (IntegrableOn (selfIntegrand a η₁ η₂) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
   445	      ∫ r₂ in Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ r₁ in Ioi (0:ℝ),
   446	          exp (-η₁ * r₁ - η₂ * r₂) * r₂ ^ (-a) * (r₁ / 2) =
   447	        Gamma (1 - a) / (2 * η₁ ^ 2 * η₂ ^ (1 - a))) := by
   448	  refine ⟨cross_transform_iterated ha0 ha1 hθ₁ hθ₂, fun θ hθ => ?_, ?_⟩
   449	  · obtain ⟨hI, hV⟩ := cross_transform_iterated ha0 ha1 hθ hθ
   450	    exact ⟨hI, hV.trans (crossValue_diag a hθ)⟩
   451	  · obtain ⟨hI, -, hV⟩ := self_transform ha1 hη₁ hη₂
   452	    exact ⟨hI, hV⟩
   453	
   454	end StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.WhiteClockLaplace

    19	  Mathlib's `Complex.betaIntegral`.

    52	/-- The Beta integrand `t^{x-1}(1-t)^{y-1}`. -/
    53	def betaKernel (x y : ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := t ^ (x - 1) * (1 - t) ^ (y - 1)
    54	
    55	/-- The manuscript's `Beta(x,y) = ∫_0^1 t^{x-1}(1-t)^{y-1} dt` (TeX line 10). -/
    56	def Beta (x y : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, betaKernel x y t
    57	
    58	lemma cplx_kernel_eq (x y t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    59	    (t : ℂ) ^ ((x : ℂ) - 1) * (1 - (t : ℂ)) ^ ((y : ℂ) - 1) = (betaKernel x y t : ℂ) := by
    60	  unfold betaKernel
    61	  rw [Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_cpow ht.1, Complex.ofReal_cpow (by linarith [ht.2])]
    62	  push_cast; ring_nf

    64	theorem betaKernel_integrableOn {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    65	    IntegrableOn (betaKernel x y) (Ioo 0 1) := by
    66	  have h := Complex.betaIntegral_convergent (u := (x : ℂ)) (v := (y : ℂ)) (by simpa) (by simpa)
    67	  rw [intervalIntegrable_iff_integrableOn_Ioc_of_le zero_le_one] at h
    68	  have h2 := h.re
    69	  refine (h2.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ioc).mono_set Ioo_subset_Ioc_self
    70	  intro t ht
    71	  simp only
    72	  rw [cplx_kernel_eq x y t ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩]; simp

    74	theorem Beta_eq_Gamma {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    75	    Beta x y = Gamma x * Gamma y / Gamma (x + y) := by
    76	  have hG := Complex.Gamma_mul_Gamma_eq_betaIntegral (s := (x : ℂ)) (t := (y : ℂ))
    77	    (by simpa) (by simpa)
    78	  have hB : Complex.betaIntegral x y = (Beta x y : ℂ) := by
    79	    unfold Complex.betaIntegral Beta
    80	    rw [← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
    81	      ← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    82	    refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun t ht => ?_
    83	    rw [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
    84	    exact cplx_kernel_eq x y t ht
    85	  rw [hB, ← Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.Gamma_ofReal, Complex.Gamma_ofReal,
    86	    Complex.Gamma_ofReal] at hG
    87	  have hpos : 0 < Gamma (x + y) := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)
    88	  have hG' : Gamma x * Gamma y = Gamma (x + y) * Beta x y := by exact_mod_cast hG
    89	  field_simp
    90	  linarith

    95	  mul_nonneg (rpow_nonneg ht.1.le _) (rpow_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2]) _)

    97	theorem lintegral_betaKernel {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    98	    ∫⁻ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (betaKernel x y t) = ENNReal.ofReal (Beta x y) := by
    99	  unfold Beta
   100	  rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (betaKernel_integrableOn hx hy)]
   101	  exact ae_restrict_of_forall_mem measurableSet_Ioo fun t ht => betaKernel_nonneg x y ht

   103	theorem Beta_pos {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) : 0 < Beta x y := by
   104	  rw [Beta_eq_Gamma hx hy]
   105	  exact div_pos (mul_pos (Gamma_pos_of_pos hx) (Gamma_pos_of_pos hy))
   106	    (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith))

   108	/-- Affine Beta integral on `(u, s)`. -/
   109	theorem lintegral_affine_beta {u s p q : ℝ} (hus : u < s) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
   110	    ∫⁻ t in Ioo u s, ENNReal.ofReal ((s - t) ^ (p - 1) * (t - u) ^ (q - 1))
   111	      = ENNReal.ofReal ((s - u) ^ (p + q - 1) * Beta q p) := by
   112	  have hd : 0 < s - u := sub_pos.mpr hus
   113	  have himg : (fun v : ℝ => u + (s - u) * v) '' Ioo 0 1 = Ioo u s := by
   114	    ext x; constructor
   115	    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
   116	      exact ⟨by nlinarith [hv.1], by nlinarith [hv.2]⟩
   117	    · intro hx
   118	      refine ⟨(x - u) / (s - u), ⟨div_pos (by linarith [hx.1]) hd, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
   119	      · rw [div_lt_one hd]; linarith [hx.2]
   120	      · field_simp; ring
   121	  rw [← himg, lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul measurableSet_Ioo
   122	    (f' := fun _ => s - u)]
   123	  rotate_left
   124	  · intro v _
   125	    have := ((hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (s - u)).const_add u
   126	    simpa using this.hasDerivWithinAt
   127	  · intro v₁ _ v₂ _ h
   128	    simpa [hd.ne'] using h
   129	  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity), ← lintegral_betaKernel hq hp,
   130	    ← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
   131	  refine setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo fun v hv => ?_
   132	  rw [abs_of_pos hd, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hd.le, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
   133	  congr 1
   134	  have h1 : s - (u + (s - u) * v) = (s - u) * (1 - v) := by ring
   135	  have h2 : u + (s - u) * v - u = (s - u) * v := by ring
   136	  have hv1 : 0 < 1 - v := by linarith [hv.2]
   137	  rw [h1, h2, mul_rpow hd.le hv1.le, mul_rpow hd.le hv.1.le]
   138	  unfold betaKernel
   139	  have : (s - u) ^ (p + q - 1) = (s - u) * (s - u) ^ (p - 1) * (s - u) ^ (q - 1) := by
   140	    rw [mul_assoc, ← rpow_add hd]
   141	    nth_rewrite 2 [← rpow_one (s - u)]
   142	    rw [← rpow_add hd]
   143	    congr 1; ring
   144	  rw [this]; ring

   146	/-- Reflection `x ↦ 1 - x`. -/
   147	theorem lintegral_reflect (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (p q : ℝ) :
   148	    ∫⁻ x in Ioo p q, F x = ∫⁻ x in Ioo (1 - q) (1 - p), F (1 - x) := by
   149	  have himg : (fun x : ℝ => 1 - x) '' Ioo (1 - q) (1 - p) = Ioo p q := by
   150	    ext x; constructor
   151	    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩; exact ⟨by linarith [hv.2], by linarith [hv.1]⟩
   152	    · intro hx; exact ⟨1 - x, ⟨by linarith [hx.2], by linarith [hx.1]⟩, by ring⟩
   153	  rw [← himg, lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul measurableSet_Ioo (f' := fun _ => -1)]
   154	  · simp
   155	  · intro v _
   156	    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id v).const_sub 1).hasDerivWithinAt
   157	  · intro v₁ _ v₂ _ h; simpa using h

   159	/-- Splitting `(0,1)` at `s ∈ [0,1]` (the point `s` is null). -/
   160	theorem lintegral_split (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
   161	    ∫⁻ x in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, F x = (∫⁻ x in Ioo 0 s, F x) + ∫⁻ x in Ioo s 1, F x := by
   162	  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ioo (0:ℝ) s) (Ioo s 1) :=
   163	    Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x h1 h2 => by linarith [h1.2, h2.1]
   164	  refine (setLIntegral_congr (ae_eq_set.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)).trans
   165	    (lintegral_union measurableSet_Ioo hdisj)
   166	  · refine measure_mono_null (t := {s}) ?_ (measure_singleton s)
   167	    intro x hx
   168	    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_Ioo, not_or, not_and, not_lt] at hx
   169	    simp only [mem_singleton_iff]
   170	    rcases hx with ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, ha, hb⟩
   171	    by_contra hne
   172	    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
   173	    · exact absurd (ha h0) (not_le.mpr h)
   174	    · exact absurd (hb h) (not_le.mpr h1)
   175	  · have : (Ioo 0 s ∪ Ioo s 1) \ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 = ∅ := by
   176	      ext x; simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_union, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
   177	      rintro ⟨h | h, h'⟩
   178	      · exact h' ⟨h.1, by linarith [hs.2, h.2]⟩
   179	      · exact h' ⟨by linarith [hs.1, h.1], h.2⟩
   180	    rw [this, measure_empty]

   183	lemma mobius_pointwise {r t v : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) (hv : v ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) :
   184	    t * (1 - t) / (1 - t + t * v) ^ 2 *
   185	      ((t - t * v / (1 - t + t * v)) ^ (-(2 * r)) * betaKernel r r (t * v / (1 - t + t * v)))
   186	      = (t * (1 - t)) ^ (-r) * betaKernel r (1 - 2 * r) v := by
   187	  obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := ht
   188	  obtain ⟨v0, v1⟩ := hv
   189	  have hT : 0 < 1 - t := by linarith
   190	  have hV : 0 < 1 - v := by linarith
   191	  have hD : 0 < 1 - t + t * v := by nlinarith
   192	  set D := 1 - t + t * v with hDdef
   193	  have e1 : t - t * v / D = t * (1 - t) * (1 - v) / D := by
   194	    field_simp; rw [hDdef]; ring
   195	  have e2 : 1 - t * v / D = (1 - t) / D := by
   196	    field_simp; rw [hDdef]; ring
   197	  unfold betaKernel
   198	  rw [e1, e2]
   199	  have p1 : 0 < t * (1 - t) * (1 - v) / D := by positivity
   200	  have p2 : 0 < t * v / D := by positivity
   201	  have p3 : 0 < (1 - t) / D := by positivity
   202	  have p4 : 0 < t * (1 - t) := by positivity
   203	  have p5 : 0 < t * (1 - t) / D ^ 2 := by positivity
   204	  rw [rpow_def_of_pos p1, rpow_def_of_pos p2, rpow_def_of_pos p3, rpow_def_of_pos p4,
   205	    rpow_def_of_pos v0, rpow_def_of_pos hV, ← exp_log p5]
   206	  have l1 : log (t * (1 - t) * (1 - v) / D) = log t + log (1 - t) + log (1 - v) - log D := by
   207	    rw [log_div (by positivity) hD.ne', log_mul (by positivity) hV.ne',
   208	      log_mul t0.ne' hT.ne']
   209	  have l2 : log (t * v / D) = log t + log v - log D := by
   210	    rw [log_div (by positivity) hD.ne', log_mul t0.ne' v0.ne']
   211	  have l3 : log ((1 - t) / D) = log (1 - t) - log D := log_div hT.ne' hD.ne'
   212	  have l4 : log (t * (1 - t)) = log t + log (1 - t) := log_mul t0.ne' hT.ne'
   213	  have l5 : log (t * (1 - t) / D ^ 2) = log t + log (1 - t) - 2 * log D := by
   214	    rw [log_div p4.ne' (by positivity), l4, log_pow]; push_cast; ring
   215	  rw [l1, l2, l3, l4, l5, ← exp_add, ← exp_add, ← exp_add, ← exp_add, ← exp_add]
   216	  congr 1; ring

   219	    (fun v : ℝ => t * v / (1 - t + t * v)) '' Ioo 0 1 = Ioo 0 t := by
   220	  obtain ⟨t0, t1⟩ := ht

   411	    IntegrableOn (fun t : ℝ => t ^ (x - 1) * (1 - t) ^ (y - 1)) (Ioo 0 1) :=
   412	  betaKernel_integrableOn hx hy
   413	
   414	/-- The manuscript's Beta agrees with Mathlib's `Complex.betaIntegral`. -/
   415	theorem Beta_eq_betaIntegral (x y : ℝ) : Complex.betaIntegral x y = (Beta x y : ℂ) := by
   416	  unfold Complex.betaIntegral Beta
   417	  rw [← integral_Ioc_eq_integral_Ioo, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le zero_le_one,
   418	    ← intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
   419	  refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr fun t ht => ?_
   420	  rw [uIcc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
   421	  exact cplx_kernel_eq x y t ht
   422	
   423	/-! ### Lemma `L:equilibrium-gamma-beta` (TeX lines 13--22) -/
   424	
   425	/-- TeX line 16: `Γ_E(x+1) = x Γ_E(x)` for `x > 0`. -/
   426	theorem gamma_beta_recurrence {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : Gamma (x + 1) = x * Gamma x :=
   427	  Gamma_add_one hx.ne'
   428	
   429	/-- TeX lines 17--18: `Beta(x,y) = Γ_E(x)Γ_E(y)/Γ_E(x+y)` for `x, y > 0`. -/
   430	theorem gamma_beta_beta_gamma {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
   431	    Beta x y = Gamma x * Gamma y / Gamma (x + y) :=
   432	  Beta_eq_Gamma hx hy
   433	
   434	/-- Duplication for every real `x` (Mathlib's Legendre formula; no sign
   435	hypothesis needed). -/
   436	theorem gamma_beta_duplication_general (x : ℝ) :
   437	    Gamma (2 * x) = 2 ^ (2 * x - 1) * Gamma x * Gamma (x + 1 / 2) / √π := by
   438	  have h := Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half x
   439	  have hpi : 0 < √π := sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
   440	  have h2 : (2:ℝ) ^ (2 * x - 1) * (2:ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * x) = 1 := by

441	    rw [← rpow_add two_pos]; simp
   442	  rw [eq_div_iff hpi.ne']
   443	  linear_combination (-(Gamma (2 * x) * √π)) * h2 - (2:ℝ) ^ (2 * x - 1) * h
   444	
   445	/-- TeX lines 19--20 (duplication): `Γ_E(2x) = 2^{2x-1} Γ_E(x) Γ_E(x+1/2)/√π`
   446	for `x > 0` (the manuscript's hypothesis; the general version above shows it
   447	is not needed). -/
   448	theorem gamma_beta_duplication {x : ℝ} (_hx : 0 < x) :
   449	    Gamma (2 * x) = 2 ^ (2 * x - 1) * Gamma x * Gamma (x + 1 / 2) / √π :=
   450	  gamma_beta_duplication_general x
   451	
   452	/-- Proof step (TeX lines 28--29): `Beta(x,x) = 2^{1-2x} Beta(1/2,x)`, and
   453	`Γ_E(1/2) = √π`. -/
   454	theorem gamma_beta_proof_steps {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
   455	    Beta x x = 2 ^ (1 - 2 * x) * Beta (1 / 2) x ∧ Gamma (1 / 2) = √π := by
   456	  refine ⟨?_, Gamma_one_half_eq⟩
   457	  rw [Beta_eq_Gamma hx hx, Beta_eq_Gamma (by norm_num) hx, Gamma_one_half_eq, ← two_mul,
   458	    add_comm (1 / 2) x, gamma_beta_duplication hx]
   459	  have hpi : 0 < √π := sqrt_pos.mpr pi_pos
   460	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos hx
   461	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < x + 1 / 2)
   462	  have hB : (2:ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 * x) = ((2:ℝ) ^ (2 * x - 1))⁻¹ := by
   463	    rw [← rpow_neg two_pos.le]; ring_nf
   464	  have h3 : (0:ℝ) < 2 ^ (2 * x - 1) := rpow_pos_of_pos two_pos _
   465	  rw [hB]
   466	  field_simp
   467	
   468	/-- Lemma `L:equilibrium-gamma-beta`, all three identities, under exactly the
   469	manuscript hypothesis "for positive arguments" (`x > 0`, `y > 0`). -/
   470	theorem gamma_beta_paper {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
   471	    Gamma (x + 1) = x * Gamma x ∧
   472	      Beta x y = Gamma x * Gamma y / Gamma (x + y) ∧
   473	      Gamma (2 * x) = 2 ^ (2 * x - 1) * Gamma x * Gamma (x + 1 / 2) / √π :=
   474	  ⟨gamma_beta_recurrence hx, gamma_beta_beta_gamma hx hy, gamma_beta_duplication hx⟩
   475	
   476	/-! ### Lemma `L:temporal-equilibrium` (TeX lines 37--51) -/
   477	
   478	/-- The density `f_a(t) = [t(1-t)]^{-r}/(Γ_E(r)Γ_E(1-r))`, `r = (1-a)/2`
   479	(TeX line 40, `E:temporal-equilibrium-density`). -/
   480	def density (a t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
   481	  (t * (1 - t)) ^ (-((1 - a) / 2)) / (Gamma ((1 - a) / 2) * Gamma (1 - (1 - a) / 2))
   482	
   483	/-- The mass `M_a = ∫_0^1 f_a(t) dt` (TeX line 46). -/
   484	def mass (a : ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, density a t
   485	
   486	lemma normalizer_pos {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   487	    0 < Gamma ((1 - a) / 2) * Gamma (1 - (1 - a) / 2) :=
   488	  mul_pos (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith)) (Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith))
   489	
   490	lemma measurable_density (a : ℝ) : Measurable (density a) := by
   491	  unfold density; fun_prop
   492	
   493	/-- Positivity (TeX line 42): `f_a(t) > 0` for `0 < t < 1`. -/
   494	theorem density_pos {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   495	    ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, 0 < density a t := by
   496	  intro t ht
   497	  have : 0 < t * (1 - t) := mul_pos ht.1 (by linarith [ht.2])
   498	  exact div_pos (rpow_pos_of_pos this _) (normalizer_pos ha0 ha1)
   499	
   500	lemma rpow_prod_eq_betaKernel {t p : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) :
   501	    (t * (1 - t)) ^ (-p) = betaKernel (1 - p) (1 - p) t := by
   502	  unfold betaKernel
   503	  rw [mul_rpow ht.1.le (by linarith [ht.2])]
   504	  congr 2 <;> ring
   505	
   506	/-- `f_a ∈ L^1(0,1)` (TeX line 42), as integrability on `(0,1)`. -/
   507	theorem density_integrableOn {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   508	    IntegrableOn (density a) (Ioo 0 1) := by
   509	  have h : IntegrableOn (fun t => betaKernel (1 - (1 - a) / 2) (1 - (1 - a) / 2) t /
   510	      (Gamma ((1 - a) / 2) * Gamma (1 - (1 - a) / 2))) (Ioo 0 1) :=
   511	    (betaKernel_integrableOn (x := 1 - (1 - a) / 2) (y := 1 - (1 - a) / 2)
   512	      (by linarith) (by linarith)).div_const _
   513	  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun h (fun t ht => ?_) measurableSet_Ioo
   514	  simp only [density]
   515	  rw [rpow_prod_eq_betaKernel ht]
   516	
   517	/-- `f_a ∈ L^1(0,1)` as `MemLp _ 1`. -/
   518	theorem density_memLp_one {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   519	    MemLp (density a) 1 (volume.restrict (Ioo 0 1)) :=
   520	  memLp_one_iff_integrable.mpr (density_integrableOn ha0 ha1)
   521	
   522	/-- `f_a ∈ L^2(0,1)` (TeX line 42): `f_a²` is integrable on `(0,1)`.  Only
   523	`a > 0` is used (`-2r = a - 1 > -1`, TeX line 85); `a < 1` is the lemma's
   524	standing hypothesis and is kept for fidelity. -/
   525	theorem density_sq_integrableOn {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (_ha1 : a < 1) :
   526	    IntegrableOn (fun t => density a t ^ 2) (Ioo 0 1) := by
   527	  have h : IntegrableOn (fun t => betaKernel a a t /
   528	      (Gamma ((1 - a) / 2) * Gamma (1 - (1 - a) / 2)) ^ 2) (Ioo 0 1) :=
   529	    (betaKernel_integrableOn (x := a) (y := a) ha0 ha0).div_const _
   530	  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun h (fun t ht => ?_) measurableSet_Ioo
   531	  have hp : 0 < t * (1 - t) := mul_pos ht.1 (by linarith [ht.2])
   532	  have hsq : ((t * (1 - t)) ^ (-((1 - a) / 2))) ^ 2 = betaKernel a a t := by
   533	    rw [← rpow_natCast, ← rpow_mul hp.le]
   534	    have e : -((1 - a) / 2) * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) = -(1 - a) := by push_cast; ring
   535	    rw [e, rpow_prod_eq_betaKernel ht, sub_sub_cancel]
   536	  simp only [density]
   537	  rw [div_pow, hsq]
   538	
   539	/-- `f_a ∈ L^2(0,1)` as `MemLp _ 2`. -/
   540	theorem density_memLp_two {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   541	    MemLp (density a) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioo 0 1)) :=
   542	  (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (measurable_density a).aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
   543	    (density_sq_integrableOn ha0 ha1)
   544	
   545	/-- From a finite `ℝ≥0∞` value of a nonnegative integrand to integrability and
   546	the Bochner value. -/
   547	lemma integrableOn_and_integral_of_lintegral {f : ℝ → ℝ} {S : Set ℝ} (hS : MeasurableSet S)
   548	    (hf : Measurable f) (hnn : ∀ t ∈ S, 0 ≤ f t) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
   549	    (h : ∫⁻ t in S, ENNReal.ofReal (f t) = ENNReal.ofReal c) :
   550	    IntegrableOn f S ∧ ∫ t in S, f t = c := by
   551	  have hae : 0 ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict S] f := ae_restrict_of_forall_mem hS hnn
   552	  refine ⟨⟨hf.aestronglyMeasurable, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal hae).mpr ?_⟩, ?_⟩
   553	  · rw [h]; exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
   554	  · rw [integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae hae hf.aestronglyMeasurable, h,
   555	      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hc]
   556	
   557	/-- The potential identity (TeX lines 44--45,
   558	`E:temporal-equilibrium-potential`): for `0 < a < 1` and every `s ∈ [0,1]`
   559	(endpoints included), the integrand is integrable on `(0,1)` and
   560	`∫_0^1 |s-t|^{-a} f_a(t) dt = 1`. -/
   561	theorem potential_eq_one {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   562	    ∀ s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
   563	      IntegrableOn (fun t => |s - t| ^ (-a) * density a t) (Ioo 0 1) ∧
   564	        ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, |s - t| ^ (-a) * density a t = 1 := by
   565	  intro s hs
   566	  set r := (1 - a) / 2 with hr
   567	  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
   568	  have hr1 : r < 1 / 2 := by linarith
   569	  have hC := normalizer_pos ha0 ha1
   570	  have e1 : 1 - 2 * r = a := by rw [hr]; ring
   571	  have e2 : 2 * r - 1 = -a := by rw [hr]; ring
   572	  refine integrableOn_and_integral_of_lintegral measurableSet_Ioo
   573	    (by unfold density; fun_prop) (fun t ht => mul_nonneg (rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _)
   574	      (density_pos ha0 ha1 t ht).le) zero_le_one ?_
   575	  have hP := lintegral_potential hr0 hr1 hs
   576	  rw [Beta_combo hr0 hr1, e2] at hP
   577	  have : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (|s - t| ^ (-a) * density a t)
   578	      = ENNReal.ofReal (|s - t| ^ (-a) * (t * (1 - t)) ^ (-r)) *
   579	        ENNReal.ofReal (Gamma r * Gamma (1 - r))⁻¹ := by
   580	    intro t ht
   581	    have hp : 0 ≤ t * (1 - t) := mul_nonneg ht.1.le (by linarith [ht.2])
   582	    rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg (rpow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _) (rpow_nonneg hp _))]
   583	    congr 1
   584	    simp only [density, ← hr]
   585	    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]; ring
   586	  rw [setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo this,
   587	    lintegral_mul_const' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top, hP, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by
   588	      rw [hr]; exact hC.le), mul_inv_cancel₀ (by rw [hr]; exact hC.ne')]
   589	
   590	/-- The mass (TeX lines 46--48, `E:temporal-equilibrium-mass`): `f_a` is
   591	integrable on `(0,1)` and
   592	`M_a = Γ_E((1+a)/2) / (Γ_E(1+a) Γ_E((1-a)/2))`. -/
   593	theorem mass_eq {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   594	    IntegrableOn (density a) (Ioo 0 1) ∧
   595	      mass a = Gamma ((1 + a) / 2) / (Gamma (1 + a) * Gamma ((1 - a) / 2)) := by
   596	  refine ⟨density_integrableOn ha0 ha1, ?_⟩
   597	  have e : 1 - (1 - a) / 2 = (1 + a) / 2 := by ring
   598	  have hcongr : ∀ t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, density a t = betaKernel ((1 + a) / 2) ((1 + a) / 2) t /
   599	      (Gamma ((1 - a) / 2) * Gamma ((1 + a) / 2)) := by
   600	    intro t ht
   601	    simp only [density]
   602	    rw [rpow_prod_eq_betaKernel ht, e]
   603	  unfold mass
   604	  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo hcongr, integral_div]
   605	  change Beta _ _ / _ = _
   606	  rw [Beta_eq_Gamma (by linarith) (by linarith)]
   607	  have e2 : (1 + a) / 2 + (1 + a) / 2 = 1 + a := by ring
   608	  rw [e2]
   609	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (1 + a) / 2)
   610	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (1 - a) / 2)
   611	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + a)
   612	  field_simp
   613	
   614	/-- `M_a > 0` (TeX line 48). -/
   615	theorem mass_pos {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) : 0 < mass a := by
   616	  rw [(mass_eq ha0 ha1).2]
   617	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (1 + a) / 2)
   618	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < (1 - a) / 2)
   619	  have := Gamma_pos_of_pos (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1 + a)
   620	  positivity
   621	
   622	/-- Remark (not in the TeX): by Euler reflection the normalizer is
   623	`Γ_E(r) Γ_E(1-r) = π / sin(π r)`. -/
   624	theorem normalizer_eq_pi_div_sin (a : ℝ) :
   625	    Gamma ((1 - a) / 2) * Gamma (1 - (1 - a) / 2) = π / sin (π * ((1 - a) / 2)) :=
   626	  Gamma_mul_Gamma_one_sub _
   627	
   628	/-- Lemma `L:temporal-equilibrium`, under exactly its hypothesis `0 < a < 1`
   629	(with `r = (1-a)/2` built into `density`): `f_a` is positive on `(0,1)`,
   630	belongs to `L^1(0,1) ∩ L^2(0,1)`, has potential identically `1` on `[0,1]`
   631	(with integrability), and its mass is
   632	`Γ_E((1+a)/2)/(Γ_E(1+a)Γ_E((1-a)/2)) > 0`. -/
   633	theorem temporal_equilibrium_paper {a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) :
   634	    (∀ t ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, 0 < density a t) ∧
   635	      MemLp (density a) 1 (volume.restrict (Ioo 0 1)) ∧
   636	      MemLp (density a) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioo 0 1)) ∧
   637	      (∀ s ∈ Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
   638	        IntegrableOn (fun t => |s - t| ^ (-a) * density a t) (Ioo 0 1) ∧
   639	          ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, |s - t| ^ (-a) * density a t = 1) ∧
   640	      (IntegrableOn (density a) (Ioo 0 1) ∧
   641	        ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, density a t
   642	          = Gamma ((1 + a) / 2) / (Gamma (1 + a) * Gamma ((1 - a) / 2))) ∧
   643	      0 < ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, density a t :=
   644	  ⟨density_pos ha0 ha1, density_memLp_one ha0 ha1, density_memLp_two ha0 ha1,
   645	    potential_eq_one ha0 ha1, mass_eq ha0 ha1, mass_pos ha0 ha1⟩
   646	
   647	end StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.TemporalEquilibrium

     1	\section{The temporal equilibrium density}
     2	\label{S:temporal-equilibrium}
     3	
     4	The density in Lemma~\ref{L:temporal-equilibrium} is the classical interval
     5	Riesz equilibrium density. Its probability-normalized form on $[-1,1]$ is
     6	recalled by Calef and Hardin~\cite{calef.hardin:source2008:riesz}*{p.~1}.
     7	We prove the potential identity with the normalization used here.
     8	
     9	We use Euler's function $\Gamma_E(x) = \int_0^\infty u^{x-1}e^{-u}\ud u$, $x >
    10	0$, and $\operatorname{Beta}(x,y) = \int_0^1t^{x-1}(1-t)^{y-1}\ud t$, $x,y > 0$.
    11	Both integrals are positive and finite.
    12	
    13	\begin{lemma}[Gamma and Beta identities]\label{L:equilibrium-gamma-beta}
    14	  For positive arguments,
    15	  \begin{align*}
    16	    \Gamma_E(x+1)&=x\Gamma_E(x),\\
    17	    \operatorname{Beta}(x,y)
    18	    &=\frac{\Gamma_E(x)\Gamma_E(y)}{\Gamma_E(x+y)},\\
    19	    \Gamma_E(2x)
    20	    &=\frac{2^{2x-1}\Gamma_E(x)\Gamma_E(x+1/2)}{\sqrt\pi}.
    21	  \end{align*}
    22	\end{lemma}
    23	
    24	\begin{proof}
    25	  Integration by parts gives the recurrence, with vanishing boundary terms. In
    26	  the positive product Gamma integral, use $(u,v) = (Rt,R(1-t))$, with Jacobian
    27	  $R$; Tonelli gives the Beta--Gamma identity. For the last identity, symmetry,
    28	  then $t = (1+v)/2$ and $v^2 = w$, give $\operatorname{Beta}(x,x) =
    29	  2^{1-2x}\operatorname{Beta}(1/2,x)$. Also $\Gamma_E(1/2) = \int_\R e^{-z^2}\ud
    30	  z = \sqrt\pi$: the substitution $u = z^2$ gives the first equality, and
    31	  squaring the positive Gaussian integral and using polar coordinates gives
    32	  $2\pi\int_0^\infty re^{-r^2}\ud r = \pi$. Substituting these into the
    33	  Beta--Gamma identity proves duplication. This proves
    34	  Lemma~\ref{L:equilibrium-gamma-beta}.
    35	\end{proof}
    36	
    37	\begin{lemma}[Exact potential and mass]\label{L:temporal-equilibrium}
    38	  For $0 < a < 1$ put $r = (1-a)/2$ and, for $0 < t < 1$,
    39	  \begin{equation}\label{E:temporal-equilibrium-density}
    40	    f_a(t)=\frac{[t(1-t)]^{-r}}{\Gamma_E(r)\Gamma_E(1-r)}.
    41	  \end{equation}
    42	  This positive function belongs to $L^1(0,1)\cap L^2(0,1)$, and
    43	  \begin{align}
    44	    \int_0^1|s-t|^{-a}f_a(t)\ud t&=1
    45	    &&\text{for every }s\in[0,1],\label{E:temporal-equilibrium-potential}\\
    46	    M_a:=\int_0^1f_a(t)\ud t
    47	    &=\frac{\Gamma_E((1+a)/2)}
    48	    {\Gamma_E(1+a)\Gamma_E((1-a)/2)}>0.
    49	    \label{E:temporal-equilibrium-mass}
    50	  \end{align}
    51	\end{lemma}
    52	
    53	\begin{proof}
    54	  The positive binomial series $(1-z)^{-p} = \sum_{n\ge0}(p)_nz^n/n!$, $p > 0$,
    55	  $0 \le z < 1$, follows directly as follows. Its coefficient ratio gives
    56	  uniform convergence on compact subintervals, including for its derivative.
    57	  Termwise differentiation gives $(1-z)y' = py$, $y(0) = 1$; hence $(1-z)^py$ is
    58	  constant one. Here $(p)_0 = 1$, $(p)_n = p(p+1)\cdots(p+n-1)$. All terms used
    59	  below are nonnegative, so Tonelli applies.
    60	
    61	  For $0 < s < 1$ split the integral of $|s-t|^{2r-1}[t(1-t)]^{-r}$ into left
    62	  and right parts. In the left part, $t = su$ gives
    63	  \begin{align*}
    64	    L(s)
    65	    &=s^r\int_0^1(1-u)^{2r-1}u^{-r}(1-su)^{-r}\ud u\\
    66	    &=\operatorname{Beta}(1-r,2r)s^r
    67	    \sum_{n\ge0}
    68	    \frac{(r)_n(1-r)_ns^n}{(1+r)_n n!}.
    69	  \end{align*}
    70	  The Beta ratio follows from the Gamma recurrence. Since $(r)_n/(1+r)_n =
    71	  r/(r+n)$, expanding the incomplete Beta integral gives
    72	  \[
    73	    L(s)=r\operatorname{Beta}(1-r,2r)B_s(r,r),\qquad
    74	    B_s(r,r)=\int_0^s u^{r-1}(1-u)^{r-1}\ud u.
    75	  \]
    76	  Reflection makes the right part $L(1-s)$, while symmetry gives
    77	  $B_s(r,r)+B_{1-s}(r,r) = \operatorname{Beta}(r,r)$. The full integral is
    78	  therefore $r\operatorname{Beta}(1-r,2r)\operatorname{Beta}(r,r) =
    79	  \Gamma_E(r)\Gamma_E(1-r)$. All integrals are finite because $-r > -1$ and
    80	  $2r-1 > -1$. At $s = 0$ the integral is directly $\operatorname{Beta}(r,1-r) =
    81	  \Gamma_E(r)\Gamma_E(1-r)$; $s = 1$ follows by reflection. This proves
    82	  \eqref{E:temporal-equilibrium-potential}, including the endpoints without a
    83	  limiting argument there.
    84	
    85	  Integrability and square integrability follow from $-r > -1$ and $-2r = a-1 >
    86	  -1$. Finally,
    87	  \[
    88	    M_a=
    89	    \frac{\operatorname{Beta}(1-r,1-r)}
    90	    {\Gamma_E(r)\Gamma_E(1-r)}
    91	    =\frac{\Gamma_E(1-r)}{\Gamma_E(2-2r)\Gamma_E(r)},
    92	  \]
    93	  which is~\eqref{E:temporal-equilibrium-mass}. Its time mass has not been
    94	  renormalized. This proves Lemma~\ref{L:temporal-equilibrium}.
    95	\end{proof}
